review_objective: Assess whether IT metrics evidence supports denominator consistency, source lineage, calculation integrity, reporting-period alignment, and management review.

items.title: Q4 Phishing Metric Evidence
items.content: The ITSC deck reported 150 delivered emails. KnowBe4 source export shows denominator changed to 152. Screenshot-only evidence was retained. Metric owner stated the number was corrected later. No reviewer approval or reconciliation is attached.

items.title: RCSA Control Effectiveness Metric
items.content: The reported value was presented as quarterly, but calculation logic appears cumulative year-to-date. The metric narrative says effective and green but does not show test procedure, sample basis, or reviewer approval.
